ravi: Follow-up from postmortem noticed a repeat pattern: cert roll + short BGP withdraws -> regional LB retries and SNI mismatches for ~6-8m.
maria: please list owners + brief ETAs. need to update the incident checklist.
sre_kim: i'll take the rollout hardening: switch rotator to prepare/commit with a route-convergence gate; add a propagation-metrics dashboard. ETA: 7d. JIRA: NET-2217.
greg: i'll add a short-term LB mitigation: cap retries to 2 + 2x backoff during maintenance windows under a feature flag. PR by Tue. JIRA: NET-2218.
ops_anya: i'll own tenant comms and opt-out flow; will add a short runbook entry for oncall to flip the flag. ETA: 48h. OPS-1204.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: cert-rotator canary scheduled v2.14 -> v2.15 on 2025-08-11T03:00Z; dry-run 20m prior.
sre_kim: detection rule (PromQL):
```
(sum by(region)(rate(lb_retry_total[5m])) / sum by(region)(rate(lb_request_total[5m]))) > 0.045
```
-> page SRE if sustained 8m.
greg: short investigation found BGP withdraws ~10s before spikes. filing NET-2219 to adjust peer timers/flap dampening.
ops_anya: compact action table copyable:
- sre_kim, NET-2217, prepare/commit rotator + gate, 7d
- greg, NET-2218, LB retry cap feature flag, Tue EOD
- greg, NET-2219, BGP peer timers investigation, 3d
- ops_anya, OPS-1204, comms + runbook, 48h

maria: uploaded runbook draft and comms note (internal). scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to review acceptance criteria.
ravi: using this thread as canonical tracker. post PR links and timeline updates here. :white_check_mark:
